Jin.name: Sima Chi
Jin.title: Emperor Huai
Jin.note: Captured by Han Zhao in 311, killed in 313.

Eastern Jin.name: Sima Rui
Eastern Jin.title: Emperor Yuan
Eastern Jin.note: King of Jin in 317, emperor from 318.

Eastern Jin.name: Sima Dezong
Eastern Jin.title: Emperor An
Eastern Jin.note: Huan Xuan briefly usurped the throne in 403-404.

Eastern Jin.name: Sima Dewen
Eastern Jin.title: Emperor Gong
Eastern Jin.note: Gave the throne to Liu Yu in 420.

sides.name: Wu
sides.troops_text: c. 230,000 on the books at surrender

jin-wu.note: Wang Jun's fleet burned the iron chains Wu had laid across the Yangtze.
jin-wu.note_zh: 王濬水军烧断吴人横江铁锁。

sides.name: Prince of Donghai's faction (final winner)
sides.name_zh: 东海王司马越一方（最终胜者）

eight-princes.note: Simplified: the princes formed shifting alliances from 291 to 306.
eight-princes.note_zh: 此为简化：291至306年诸王反复结盟混战。

yongjia.note: Shi Le destroyed the main Jin army at Ningping before Luoyang fell.
yongjia.note_zh: 洛阳陷落前，石勒已在宁平城全歼晋军主力。
yongjia.losses: Main Jin army destroyed; Luoyang sacked
yongjia.losses_zh: 晋军主力覆没，洛阳被焚掠

sides.name: Jin under Zu Ti
sides.troops_text: began with about 100 families of followers

zu-ti.note: After Zu Ti died in 321 most of the land was lost again.
zu-ti.note_zh: 321年祖逖死后，所复之地大多再失。

wang-dun.note: His second revolt of 324 failed and he died during it.
wang-dun.note_zh: 324年第二次起兵失败，王敦病死。

shi-le-liu-yao.note: Liu Yao was captured at Luoyang in 328; Former Zhao fell in 329.
shi-le-liu-yao.note_zh: 328年刘曜在洛阳被俘，前赵于329年灭亡。

ran-min.note: Ran Min was captured by Former Yan in 352.

sides.name: Former Qin
sides.troops_text: claimed 870,000; far fewer reached the river
sides.troops_text_zh: 号称87万，抵达淝水者远少于此

fei-river.note: Fu Jian's army fell into panic when it pulled back to let the Jin troops cross.
fei-river.note_zh: 苻坚后撤让晋军渡河时阵脚大乱。

liu-yu-changan.note: Wang Zhen'e sailed up the Wei River to Chang'an; Xia took the city in 418.
liu-yu-changan.note_zh: 王镇恶溯渭水直抵长安；418年长安又被夏国夺取。

routes.name: Wang Jun's fleet conquers Wu
routes.summary: Jin warships sailed from Sichuan down the Yangtze to Jianye, and Wu surrendered.
routes.summary_zh: 晋军楼船自蜀顺江而下直抵建业，吴国投降。

routes.name: Northern families flee south
routes.summary: After the fall of Luoyang many northern families moved south across the Yangtze; the line shows one main path.
routes.summary_zh: 洛阳陷落后大批北方士民南迁过江，此线为其中一条主要路线。

routes.name: Zu Ti's northern expedition
routes.summary: Zu Ti crossed the Yangtze at Jingkou and fought his way back to the Yellow River.
routes.summary_zh: 祖逖从京口渡江北伐，收复黄河以南大片土地。

routes.name: Huan Wen's conquest of Shu
routes.summary: Huan Wen sailed up the Yangtze and Min rivers and took Chengdu from Cheng Han.
routes.summary_zh: 桓温溯长江、岷江而上，攻取成都，灭成汉。

routes.name: Former Qin marches south
routes.summary: Fu Jian led a huge army south to conquer Jin and was routed at the Fei River.
routes.summary_zh: 苻坚率大军南下欲灭东晋，在淝水惨败。

routes.name: Liu Yu's northern expedition
routes.summary: Liu Yu's armies moved by river and road from Jiankang to take Luoyang and Chang'an.
routes.summary_zh: 刘裕水陆并进，从建康出发收复洛阳、长安。

routes.name: Faxian's journey to India
routes.summary: The monk Faxian went overland to India for Buddhist texts and came home by sea, landing in Shandong.
routes.summary_zh: 高僧法显经陆路赴天竺求经，后由海路回国，在山东登岸。

people.name: Huangfu Mi
people.known_for: Compiled the oldest surviving systematic book on acupuncture.
people.known_for_zh: 编成现存最早的系统针灸学著作。

works.title: Systematic Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion

people.name: Chen Shou
people.known_for: Wrote the official history of the Three Kingdoms.
people.known_for_zh: 撰写三国时期的正史。

people.name: Lu Ji
people.known_for: Poet and critic whose 'Rhapsody on Literature' is a classic of literary theory.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和文论家，《文赋》是文学理论名篇。

people.name: Zuo Si
people.known_for: His 'Three Capitals' rhapsody was copied so eagerly that paper prices rose in Luoyang.
people.known_for_zh: 所作《三都赋》传抄者众，使“洛阳纸贵”。

people.name: Ge Hong
people.known_for: Daoist writer and alchemist who recorded early recipes for medicine and immortality.
people.known_for_zh: 道教学者、炼丹家，记录了许多早期医方与炼丹术。

people.name: Wang Xizhi
people.known_for: Revered as the 'Sage of Calligraphy'.
people.known_for_zh: 被尊为“书圣”。

works.title: Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Poems

people.line_zh: 是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅。
people.line_en: On this day the sky was bright and the air clear, and a gentle breeze blew.

people.name: Dao'an
people.known_for: Monk who catalogued Buddhist scriptures and gave Chinese monks the surname Shi.
people.known_for_zh: 高僧，编订佛经目录，并规定僧人以“释”为姓。

people.name: Faxian
people.known_for: Monk who walked to India in 399 and returned by sea in 412 with Buddhist texts.
people.known_for_zh: 399年从长安出发步行到印度求法，412年经海路带经书回国。

people.name: Gu Kaizhi
people.known_for: The most famous early Chinese figure painter.
people.known_for_zh: 中国早期最著名的人物画家。

works.title: Admonitions of the Instructress to the Court Ladies

people.name: Kumarajiva
people.known_for: Monk from Kucha whose translations at Chang'an became the standard Chinese Buddhist scriptures.
people.known_for_zh: 龟兹高僧，在长安主持译经，其译本成为汉传佛教的通行经典。

people.name: Tao Yuanming
people.known_for: Poet of rural retirement who left office in 405 to farm.
people.known_for_zh: 田园诗人，405年辞官归隐躬耕。
people.line_zh: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山。
people.line_en: Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, I gaze at the southern hills at ease.

people.name: Sima Yan (Emperor Wu of Jin)
people.known_for: Founder of the Jin dynasty who reunified China by conquering Wu in 280.
people.known_for_zh: 建立西晋，280年灭吴统一全国。

people.name: Pei Xiu
people.known_for: Cartographer who set out six principles of map-making, including grid scale.
people.known_for_zh: 地图学家，提出“制图六体”。

works.title: Maps of the Regions of the Yu Gong

people.name: Yang Hu
people.known_for: Jin commander at Xiangyang who prepared the conquest of Wu through benevolent frontier rule.
people.known_for_zh: 镇守襄阳，以德怀柔，筹划灭吴。

people.name: Du Yu
people.known_for: General who led the conquest of Wu and scholar of the Zuo Commentary.
people.known_for_zh: 率军灭吴的统帅，著《春秋左氏经传集解》。

works.title: Collected Explanations of the Zuo Zhuan

people.name: Wang Jun
people.known_for: Admiral who built a great fleet in Sichuan and sailed down the Yangtze to take Jianye in 280.
people.known_for_zh: 在蜀造楼船，顺江而下攻破建业。

people.name: Shan Tao
people.known_for: Eldest of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove, later Jin minister of personnel.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤之一，后任西晋吏部尚书。

people.name: Wang Rong
people.known_for: Youngest of the Seven Sages, later a high Jin minister famed for his miserliness.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤中最年少者，西晋高官。

people.name: Liu Ling
people.known_for: Seven Sages member legendary for drinking, author of the Hymn to the Virtue of Wine.
people.known_for_zh: 竹林七贤之一，嗜酒，作《酒德颂》。

works.title: Hymn to the Virtue of Wine

people.name: Shi Chong
people.known_for: Fabulously rich official and poet whose Golden Valley Garden hosted literary gatherings.
people.known_for_zh: 豪富官僚、文人，金谷园雅集主人。

works.title: Preface to the Golden Valley Poems

people.name: Pan Yue
people.known_for: Celebrated handsome poet best known for his laments for his late wife.
people.known_for_zh: 西晋诗人，美男子，以《悼亡诗》著称。

people.name: Zhang Hua
people.known_for: Jin statesman and author of the Treatise on Curiosities, an encyclopaedia of marvels.
people.known_for_zh: 西晋重臣，著《博物志》。

people.name: Empress Jia Nanfeng
people.known_for: Empress whose power struggles triggered the War of the Eight Princes.
people.known_for_zh: 西晋皇后，专权引发八王之乱。

people.name: Wang Shuhe
people.known_for: Physician who compiled the Pulse Classic and re-edited Zhang Zhongjing's treatise.
people.known_for_zh: 医学家，著《脉经》，整理《伤寒论》。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia gives Wang Shuhe as c. 210?–258?, not 180–270.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称王叔和约生于210年、卒于258年，而非180–270年。

people.name: Lady Wei (Wei Shuo)
people.known_for: Calligrapher who taught the young Wang Xizhi regular script.
people.known_for_zh: 书法家，王羲之的老师。

people.name: Suo Jing
people.known_for: Calligrapher from Dunhuang renowned for zhangcao (draft cursive) script.
people.known_for_zh: 敦煌人，章草书法大家。

people.name: Liu Kun
people.known_for: Jin loyalist who held Bing Province against the Xiongnu Han-Zhao; rose at cockcrow to drill with Zu Ti.
people.known_for_zh: 坚守并州抗击刘渊，与祖逖“闻鸡起舞”。

people.name: Zu Ti
people.known_for: General who led a northern expedition to recover lost lands, vowing mid-river to return victorious.
people.known_for_zh: 中流击楫，北伐收复黄河以南失地。

people.name: Wang Dao
people.known_for: Statesman who founded the Eastern Jin with Emperor Yuan, uniting northern émigrés and southern gentry.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐晋元帝建立东晋，“王与马共天下”。

people.name: Tao Kan
people.known_for: Eastern Jin general who crushed Su Jun's rebellion; famed for carrying bricks to stay fit.
people.known_for_zh: 平定苏峻之乱，“运甓”自励，陶渊明曾祖。

people.name: Huan Wen
people.known_for: Powerful general who conquered Cheng-Han in Sichuan and led three northern expeditions.
people.known_for_zh: 灭成汉，三次北伐，权倾朝野。

people.name: Xie An
people.known_for: Eastern Jin chancellor who calmly directed victory at the Battle of Fei River in 383.
people.known_for_zh: 东晋宰相，淝水之战运筹帷幄。

people.name: Xie Xuan
people.known_for: Commander of the Beifu army who routed Fu Jian's huge army at the Fei River.
people.known_for_zh: 北府兵统帅，淝水之战大败前秦。

people.name: Fu Jian
people.known_for: Former Qin emperor who unified northern China but lost at the Fei River in 383.
people.known_for_zh: 前秦天王，统一北方，淝水之战惨败。

people.name: Wang Meng
people.known_for: Chancellor of Former Qin whose reforms made it the dominant northern power.
people.known_for_zh: 前秦丞相，整顿吏治，助苻坚统一北方。

people.name: Shi Le
people.known_for: Former slave of Jie origin who founded the Later Zhao state in northern China.
people.known_for_zh: 羯族奴隶出身，建立后赵。

people.name: Fotudeng
people.known_for: Central Asian monk who won Later Zhao rulers' patronage and spread Buddhism across the north.
people.known_for_zh: 西域高僧，受后赵崇信，在北方大弘佛法。

people.name: Huiyuan
people.known_for: Monk at Mount Lu's Donglin Temple, founder of the White Lotus Society and Pure Land tradition.
people.known_for_zh: 庐山东林寺高僧，结白莲社，净土宗初祖。

works.title: A Monk Does Not Bow Down Before a King

people.name: Guo Pu
people.known_for: Poet, diviner and commentator on the Erya and Classic of Mountains and Seas.
people.known_for_zh: 文学家、方术家，注《尔雅》《山海经》，作《游仙诗》。

people.name: Gan Bao
people.known_for: Historian who compiled In Search of the Supernatural, a key collection of zhiguai tales.
people.known_for_zh: 史学家，编《搜神记》，志怪小说代表。

people.name: Wang Xianzhi
people.known_for: Calligrapher son of Wang Xizhi; together they are the 'Two Wangs' of calligraphy.
people.known_for_zh: 王羲之之子，与父并称“二王”。

people.name: Dai Kui
people.known_for: Painter and sculptor who pioneered Chinese Buddhist sculpture and refused all office.
people.known_for_zh: 画家、雕塑家，开创中国佛像雕塑风格，隐居不仕。

people.name: Yu Xi
people.known_for: Astronomer who discovered the precession of the equinoxes in China.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，发现岁差。

people.name: Guo Xiang
people.known_for: Xuanxue philosopher whose commentary on the Zhuangzi became the standard edition.
people.known_for_zh: 玄学家，注《庄子》，成为通行本。

people.name: Chang Qu
people.known_for: Historian of Cheng-Han who wrote the Chronicles of Huayang on the history of Sichuan.
people.known_for_zh: 著《华阳国志》，记述巴蜀地方史。

people.name: Liu Yu
people.known_for: Jin general from humble origins who crushed Huan Xuan, reconquered Chang'an and founded the Liu Song in 420.
people.known_for_zh: 出身寒微，平桓玄、北伐收复长安，建立刘宋。

people.name: Zhu Shixing
people.known_for: The first Chinese monk known to travel west for scriptures, reaching Khotan in 260.
people.known_for_zh: 已知最早西行求法的汉地僧人，260年抵达于阗。

people.name: Liu Hui
people.known_for: Mathematician whose 263 commentary on the Nine Chapters computed pi by polygon approximation.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，263年注《九章算术》，用割圆术计算圆周率。

people.name: Kang Senghui
people.known_for: Sogdian monk born in Jiaozhi who brought Buddhism to Wu and founded Jianchu Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 祖籍康居的僧人，于建业创建建初寺，佛教传入江南。

people.name: Dong Feng
people.known_for: Physician on Mount Lu who asked patients to plant apricot trees as fees, origin of 'apricot grove' for medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 庐山名医，病愈者植杏为酬，“杏林”典故出处。

people.name: Xie Lingyun
people.known_for: Founder of Chinese landscape poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 中国山水诗的开创者。

works.title: Climbing the Tower by the Pond

people.line_zh: 池塘生春草，园柳变鸣禽。
people.line_en: Spring grass grows by the pond; in the garden willows, new birds sing.

people.name: Cui Hao
people.known_for: Han Chinese chief adviser to Northern Wei emperors, executed over his frank state history.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏重臣、谋略家，因国史案被诛。

people.name: Tan Daoji
people.known_for: Leading Liu Song general famed for his stratagems, executed by a suspicious court.
people.known_for_zh: 刘宋名将，以计谋著称，后遭猜忌被杀，有“自毁长城”之叹。

people.name: Pei Songzhi
people.known_for: Historian whose rich annotations to the Records of the Three Kingdoms preserved many lost sources.
people.known_for_zh: 史学家，为《三国志》作注，保存大量史料。

works.title: Annotations to Records of the Three Kingdoms

people.name: Yan Yanzhi
people.known_for: Ornate Liu Song poet, ranked with Xie Lingyun as the leading writers of the Yuanjia era.
people.known_for_zh: 刘宋诗人，与谢灵运并称“颜谢”。

people.name: Kou Qianzhi
people.known_for: Daoist reformer whose Northern Celestial Masters became the state religion of Northern Wei.
people.known_for_zh: 道教改革家，创北天师道，被北魏奉为国教。

people.name: He Chengtian
people.known_for: Astronomer and mathematician who created the Yuanjia calendar and an interpolation method.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家、数学家，制《元嘉历》。

capitals.name: Chang'an
capitals.note: Last refuge of the Western Jin court.

capitals.name: Jiankang
capitals.note: The Jin court re-established in the south.

capitals.name: Pingcheng
capitals.note: Moved to Luoyang under Emperor Xiaowen.

capitals.name: Tongwan
capitals.note: Helian Bobo's white-walled city on the Ordos.
capitals.note_zh: 赫连勃勃在鄂尔多斯南缘所筑的白城。
